system.description:
Hissing and baring your fangs, you let your vampiric features rise to the fore and drive supernatural terror into the heart of your victim.

Make a Social Challenge against your foe (retest Leadership). On a success the subject flees your presence and tries to avoid you for the rest of the scene or hour. If cornered they defend themselves normally, but must risk an additional Trait to attack or act against you, just as if wounded. Using this power requires you (in character) to hiss and bare your fangs, so it is an obvious breach of the Masquerade.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
